title: Current and published truth is exact-subject, fresh, renderer-valid, and deployment-proven
statement: A current DEVAI scorecard projection MUST consume one explicit schema-valid non-synthetic scorecard whose integration_head equals the declared full scorecard_subject_sha and whose generated_at is within the declared maximum age; scorecard_subject_sha, render_source_sha, and deployed_source_sha MUST remain separate and joined by a mechanically observation-only projection diff plus exact gh-pages provenance; current public claims and stable/current version labels MUST agree with machine truth, adopter guides MUST have one canonical docs/adopters location with no active stale inbound path, and invalid, stale, missing, placeholder, experimental, renderer-broken, deployment-unreachable, provenance-ambiguous, or false-current inputs MUST NOT overwrite current output or promote supported readiness.
rationale: A generated page changes HEAD and a deployed site has another source identity. Conflating those identities or selecting evidence by filename, mtime, or fallback creates false-current self-application evidence.

strategy.rationale: The registered test corpus provides deterministic regression evidence for this invariant.
